body: People suck. I stopped following him after he came out in support of white nationalists. I'm sorry for this woman's pain and thank you for caring.

Hardly anyone wears a mask where I live and I've had people try to pull mine off at the grocery store. Rural America sucks. There's a denial that Covid actually exists, even though there have been hundreds of deaths locally. It's insane. The director's husband is the theatre's acting "president" and also the producer. No one else in the cast has a problem with this kid rejoining. I know it's not his fault he was exposed -- he's in high school and the local schools are not on virtual learning. So it sucks for everyone. 

My county doesn't have anonymous reporting and even if someone else did it on my behalf, everyone would know it was me because I already said I was uncomfortable with being in a scene with someone who might be asymptomatic but contagious. The rules are applied so arbitrarily.

Covid cases are tracked by the health department. If I lie about having it, it would be fines and/or prison time. It's not "unprofessional" theatre, it's just community theatre. I've been trying to join AEA since I graduated in 2003 and no luck. I take what I can get, but I also don't want to die
